scope: 100 prioritized feature families from 10 representative editors; not an exhaustive product matrix or ranking

products.name: Adobe Lightroom Classic
products.focus: Photo library and reversible RAW workflow

products.name: Affinity (photo editing / Pixel Studio)
products.focus: Layers, live filters and image merging

products.name: DxO PhotoLab
products.focus: RAW denoising and measured optical correction

products.name: Luminar Neo
products.focus: Portrait tools and automatic scene enhancement

psstack.title: Photoshop image stacks and Smart Objects

features.name: File and folder import
features.technique: Journal each import; hash originals; resume interrupted jobs
features.note: Five JPEG file roots passed native testing; other formats need their own fixtures

features.name: RAW decoding and demosaicing
features.technique: Extend existing safe decoder with camera-specific fixtures and fallback provenance
features.note: Coverage varies by compression; no claim of every camera

features.name: EXIF and camera/lens metadata
features.technique: Normalize metadata once; preserve unknown fields and orientation
features.note: Inspect real camera MakerNotes before expanding support

features.name: Ratings, flags and color labels
features.technique: Persist user decisions separately from automatic culling suggestions
features.note: Culling infrastructure is not proof of complete manual labeling UX

features.name: Keywords and searchable metadata
features.technique: Index editable IPTC fields; add full-text search and bulk metadata updates
features.note: Complete keyword editing and search UI not established

features.name: Collections and rule-based albums
features.technique: Store collection membership and saved predicates independently
features.note: Collections exist; general smart-album parity is unverified

features.name: Duplicate detection and skip-on-import
features.technique: Use content hashes and idempotent catalog writes; report skipped copies
features.note: Exact reimport tests passed; near-duplicate visual matching is a separate extension

features.name: Face recognition and people albums
features.technique: Use a validated detector, embeddings and user-confirmed identity clusters
features.note: Face detector is documented as untrained

features.name: Tethered capture and live view
features.technique: Add camera transport adapters, capture queue and reconnect handling
features.note: No tethering path established in the inspected implementation

features.name: Offline editable proxy previews
features.technique: Persist proxy provenance and reconcile edits when originals return
features.note: Cached previews alone do not prove offline editing

features.name: Exposure compensation
features.technique: Apply gain in linear light and journal the user's value
features.note: Manual exposure protection passed the five-photo native test

features.name: White balance temperature and tint
features.technique: Use chromatic adaptation with an optional neutral-patch picker
features.note: Controls exist; camera-specific accuracy still needs measured targets

features.name: Global contrast
features.technique: Use bounded tone shaping with stable neutral settings
features.note: Control and renderer exist; no competitor-quality benchmark

features.name: Highlight recovery
features.technique: Recover RAW channel detail before tone mapping; protect specular highlights
features.note: JPEG highlight adjustment cannot recover clipped sensor data

features.name: Shadow recovery
features.technique: Lift dark tonal ranges with noise-aware limits
features.note: Needs high-ISO and backlit RAW validation

features.name: White and black point controls
features.technique: Adjust endpoints with smooth shoulders and clipping feedback
features.note: Dedicated sliders are present

features.name: Levels and midpoint gamma
features.technique: Add input/output black-white points and midpoint gamma
features.note: Separate Levels tool not established

features.name: RGB and luminance histogram
features.technique: Measure rendered pixels with bounded sampling and channel bins
features.note: Current histogram is a preview sample, not RAW sensor data

features.name: Highlight and shadow clipping overlay
features.technique: Overlay per-pixel clipping masks with independent channel thresholds
features.note: Near-clipping percentages exist; spatial overlay is missing

features.name: One-click automatic tone enhancement
features.technique: Use bounded luminance statistics; protect manual fields; keep a neutral option
features.note: Local measured correction, not a trained subject-aware model

features.name: Point and individual RGB tone curves
features.technique: Use monotonic interpolation and cache transfer tables
features.note: Controls and renderer exist

features.name: Parametric tone curves
features.technique: Blend smooth tonal bands with ordered split points
features.note: Controls and renderer exist

features.name: HSL color mixer
features.technique: Apply soft hue-band weights with stable hue wrapping
features.note: Skin protection needs varied real-portrait evaluation

features.name: Targeted point-color editing
features.technique: Sample a pixel; edit a feathered range in perceptual color space
features.note: Fixed HSL bands are not a sampled point-color tool

features.name: Shadow/midtone/highlight color grading
features.technique: Blend tonal color wheels while controlling luminance changes
features.note: UI and recipe fields are present

features.name: Black-and-white channel mixing
features.technique: Mix source hue contributions into monochrome luminance
features.note: Monochrome controls exist

features.name: Vibrance and saturation
features.technique: Separate global chroma scaling from bounded low-chroma enhancement
features.note: Controls and renderer exist

features.name: Camera calibration and matching profiles
features.technique: Fit profiles from measured targets under controlled illuminants
features.note: Calibration controls exist; real camera profiles are missing

features.name: ICC input/display/output color management
features.technique: Keep scene-linear working pixels; transform through explicit ICC profiles
features.note: Output spaces exist; arbitrary input ICC and display parity are incomplete

features.name: Importable 3D LUT looks
features.technique: Parse cube/3DL safely; interpolate a 3D lattice with amount control
features.note: Internal curve LUTs are not user-importable 3D LUTs

features.name: Crop and aspect-ratio presets
features.technique: Store normalized crop coordinates with reversible aspect locks
features.note: Existing presets and crop recipe need broader native coverage

features.name: Straighten and horizon correction
features.technique: Use reversible rotation and optional measured line suggestions
features.note: Manual control exists; automatic quality requires validation

features.name: Rotate and mirror
features.technique: Compose orientation transforms and update crop/mask coordinates
features.note: Rotation exists; a complete mirror workflow is unverified

features.name: Perspective and keystone correction
features.technique: Apply a homography with bounded interpolation and crop preview
features.note: Code exists; architectural real-image cases remain to be tested

features.name: Lens distortion correction
features.technique: Apply calibrated radial/tangential lens models
features.note: Measured camera/lens coverage is incomplete

features.name: Chromatic aberration and defringing
features.technique: Align color channels and suppress selected edge fringes
features.note: Correction controls exist; universal lens parity is unproven

features.name: Lens vignetting compensation
features.technique: Apply calibrated radial gain before creative grading
features.note: Calibration quality remains camera/lens dependent

features.name: High-quality image resampling
features.technique: Resize in linear light with antialiasing and tile borders
features.note: Code exists; compare downsampling and enlargement fixtures

features.name: Content-aware scaling
features.technique: Evaluate seam carving with user-protected subject regions
features.note: No implementation established; keep geometry changes reversible

features.name: Liquify and mesh warping
features.technique: Use editable displacement meshes with foldover limits
features.note: Manual creative tool only; do not apply automatically to faces

features.name: Local adjustment brush
features.technique: Rasterize pressure-aware strokes into tiled alpha masks
features.note: Mask-editing infrastructure exists; complete painting UX is unverified

features.name: Linear gradient masks
features.technique: Evaluate a feathered signed-distance ramp in image coordinates
features.note: Renderer support exists; direct on-image workflow needs validation

features.name: Radial gradient masks
features.technique: Evaluate elliptical distance with feather, invert and rotate
features.note: Renderer support exists; direct manipulation needs validation

features.name: Luminance-range masks
features.technique: Map luminance into a soft threshold band
features.note: General user-authored range-mask tool not established

features.name: Color-range masks
features.technique: Use perceptual color distance with tolerance and feather
features.note: Color growth is present; full editable range workflow unverified

features.name: Automatic subject/background selection
features.technique: Run validated segmentation through the existing inference service
features.note: Segmentation heads are untrained

features.name: Automatic sky selection
features.technique: Segment sky and refine edges against foreground structures
features.note: Real-photo automatic masks are blocked by model readiness

features.name: Face, skin, hair and eye masks
features.technique: Combine face landmarks with semantic parsing and matting
features.note: Untrained face detection blocks real portrait masks

features.name: Mask feathering and edge refinement
features.technique: Use distance fields and edge-aware matting; expose mask preview
features.note: Basic operations exist; hair/veil quality is unproven

features.name: Mask add, subtract, intersect and invert
features.technique: Represent combinations as a reversible alpha-expression graph
features.note: Complete boolean authoring workflow needs verification

features.name: Spot healing and blemish repair
features.technique: Provide explicit source sampling and edge-aware patch blending
features.note: Automatic face/blemish models are not ready for real portraits

features.name: Clone stamp
features.technique: Paint from a chosen source offset with opacity and edge feather
features.note: General manual clone-stamp workflow not established

features.name: Content-aware object removal
features.technique: Start with user-selected masks; evaluate patch search and inpainting
features.note: Current automatic cleanup refuses unclassified real-image removals

features.name: Red-eye correction
features.technique: Detect pupil/redness within a user-confirmed eye region
features.note: Automatic path depends on unavailable face evidence

features.name: Texture-preserving skin smoothing
features.technique: Separate low-frequency variation from texture with strict strength limits
features.note: Retouch safeguards exist; usable real-photo masks are missing

features.name: Frequency separation
features.technique: Create reversible low/high-frequency components with neutral reconstruction
features.note: A full editable frequency-separation workflow is not established

features.name: Dodge and burn / local relighting
features.technique: Apply masked exposure and edge-aware luminance changes
features.note: Local-light infrastructure exists; depth-aware relighting is not proven

features.name: Eye and teeth enhancement
features.technique: Bound local luminance/chroma edits inside confirmed masks
features.note: Real-photo face detection remains a dependency

features.name: Skin-tone uniformity
features.technique: Reduce unwanted hue/chroma variance within protected skin masks
features.note: Measured retouch code exists; accuracy on people is unproven

features.name: Depth-aware background blur
features.technique: Estimate depth and alpha; use occlusion-aware variable-radius blur
features.note: No complete depth-bokeh workflow established

features.name: Pixel layers and layer groups
features.technique: Add a versioned document graph with ordered children and stable IDs
features.note: Current edit recipe is not a general layered document

features.name: Adjustment layers
features.technique: Represent adjustments as independently masked graph nodes
features.note: Global recipe blocks are not user-managed adjustment layers

features.name: Per-layer masks
features.technique: Attach editable alpha planes to compositing nodes
features.note: Requires a layered document model

features.name: Layer blend modes and opacity
features.technique: Implement premultiplied-alpha compositing with explicit blend space
features.note: Local edit strength is not general layer blending

features.name: Smart Objects / linked image objects
features.technique: Reference immutable source assets and retain transform/filter parameters
features.note: Requires asset references, relinking and nested rendering

features.name: Reorderable nondestructive filter stack
features.technique: Store versioned operation nodes with explicit dependencies
features.note: Existing fixed renderer stages are not a reorderable user stack

features.name: Editable text layers
features.technique: Add font shaping, text layout and resolution-independent rendering
features.note: No layered typography workflow established

features.name: Vector shapes and editable paths
features.technique: Store Bezier paths and rasterize with antialiasing at output scale
features.note: Needs document nodes and selection/path editing tools

features.name: Automatic layer alignment and blending
features.technique: Estimate transforms, compensate exposure and blend overlapping regions
features.note: No multi-source composition graph established

features.name: Editable layered document interchange
features.technique: Define native layered serialization; explicitly scope PSD/ORA interoperability
features.note: Current XMP recipes do not preserve arbitrary layered documents

features.name: Bracketed HDR merge
features.technique: Align brackets, reject motion and merge scene radiance before tone mapping
features.note: Explicitly listed as missing

features.name: Panorama stitching
features.technique: Match features, solve camera geometry, choose seams and multiband blend
features.note: Explicitly listed as missing

features.name: Focus stacking
features.technique: Align scale/focus breathing; fuse sharp regions with seam refinement
features.note: No implementation established

features.name: Multi-frame noise reduction
features.technique: Align bursts and robustly aggregate static regions with motion rejection
features.note: Current restoration is not a proven multi-frame merge tool

features.name: AI denoising
features.technique: Evaluate trained denoisers against classical baselines and identity detail
features.note: Classical restoration exists; trained model parity is unproven

features.name: Sharpening, texture, clarity and dehaze
features.technique: Use scale-aware local contrast, edge masks and bounded restoration
features.note: Controls exist; halo/noise behavior needs broader image tests

features.name: AI enlargement / super-resolution
features.technique: Tile a validated super-resolution model with overlap and detail safeguards
features.note: Do not confuse standard resizing with learned recovery

features.name: Sky replacement
features.technique: Combine sky matting, horizon alignment and editable scene relighting
features.note: Requires reliable masks and multiple source assets

features.name: Generative fill
features.technique: Store a selected-mask request and versioned generated candidates
features.note: Cleanup infrastructure is not a general prompt-fill product

features.name: Generative canvas expansion
features.technique: Extend document bounds and generate only the user-selected missing region
features.note: Requires explicit user initiation and provider/local-model integration

features.name: Presets and adjustable preset strength
features.technique: Save versioned parameter subsets and interpolate supported values
features.note: Existing presets; custom authoring/import/export still need review

features.name: Copy, paste and synchronize edits
features.technique: Apply selected recipe fields in a transactional batch
features.note: Current sync-all behavior needs selective sync expansion

features.name: Reference-image look matching
features.technique: Match bounded color/tone statistics and validate through the renderer
features.note: A statistical approximation, not recovery of another editor's settings

features.name: Nondestructive history and Undo/Redo
features.technique: Replay an append-only edit journal with explicit cursor movement
features.note: Five-photo tests passed Undo/Redo and new-edit branch behavior

features.name: Virtual copies and named snapshots
features.technique: Fork recipe references without duplicating originals
features.note: Persistent history is not a complete virtual-copy/snapshot UI

features.name: Before/after comparison and zoom
features.technique: Render matched views with a keyboard-accessible divider
features.note: Native comparison passed; exhaustive synchronized zoom parity untested

features.name: Macros, actions and plug-in scripting
features.technique: Record typed commands; validate parameters; expose a bounded extension API
features.note: Autopilot stages are not arbitrary user-authored macros

features.name: Batch editing and export queues
features.technique: Use bounded workers, cancellation checkpoints and per-item results
features.note: Five-image export passed; large-gallery capacity needs measurement

features.name: Film grain and analog looks
features.technique: Use seeded spatial grain so preview and export agree
features.note: Creative controls exist; visual calibration is not benchmarked

features.name: Creative post-crop vignette
features.technique: Evaluate feathered geometry in final output coordinates
features.note: Controls and renderer exist

features.name: JPEG/PNG/TIFF export and bit-depth options
features.technique: Keep format capabilities explicit; verify decoded output after writing
features.note: Five PNG exports verified; format/depth matrix is not fully tested

features.name: Export resizing and output sharpening
features.technique: Resize once, then sharpen for the chosen output size and medium
features.note: Do not promise identical print appearance without profiling

features.name: Batch naming and metadata/privacy controls
features.technique: Plan collision-safe names; whitelist metadata; strip location when chosen
features.note: Export policy exists; broaden metadata round-trip tests

features.name: Text and image watermarks
features.technique: Composite a positioned overlay after resize in output space
features.note: A full watermark editor/export path is not established

features.name: Soft proofing and gamut warnings
features.technique: Use display and printer profiles with selectable rendering intent
features.note: Explicitly listed as missing

features.name: Print layouts and contact sheets
features.technique: Lay out physical page units, margins and color-managed output
features.note: Exporting an album set is not a desktop print-layout engine

features.name: XMP sidecars and edit interchange
features.technique: Map supported parameters; retain unmapped data; document lossy translation
features.note: Writer exists; full cross-editor round-trip fidelity is not proven

features.name: GPU-accelerated rendering
features.technique: Connect a compute backend behind the renderer; keep tested CPU fallback
features.note: Shaders exist but no GPU backend is linked

features.name: Tiled rendering and multiresolution caching
features.technique: Cache by source/recipe/version; bound memory; prioritize visible tiles
features.note: Architecture exists; interactive latency targets need real measurement

features.name: HDR display editing and HDR export
features.technique: Add an HDR display/output path with SDR fallback and gain-map validation
features.note: Wide-gamut floating-point internals alone are not HDR delivery
